summary: Michelle Kartschoke, 46, of Prior Lake, Minnesota, fell an estimated 145-175 feet while hiking near the summit of Mount Crested Butte with family members after attempting to lower herself onto a knife ridge below the peak's flat summit; suffered significant head and body trauma and was pronounced deceased at the scene
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue; Crested Butte Mountain Resort bike patrol and staff
notes: Fall at ~12:20; CBSAR dispatched for the recovery.
